Class VideoGame

java.lang.Object
VideoGame
public class VideoGame extends Object
Serves as the object class for video games. Contains attributes such as the media type, the platforms playable on, the required specs to run the game, the developer, and the number of hours played. The class also contains methods that updates the number of hours played, returns the media type, as well as a summary of the video games which contains all aforementioned attributes.
